items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: I left the band and came back to Cincinnati, and played with Fats Waller

ctx.x: Yeah, Thamon Hayes. And then I left the band and came back to Cincinnati, and played with Fats Waller and... Well, Fats had a guy to get the band together. His name was Clarence Page. So I played with Clarence Page. He just died, incidentally, about two months ago now. He had an album of pictures that's... Boy, it's the best album I've ever seen. I was a very good friend of his. His wife promised to give me that album. You know, I wanted it. There's pictures of all the guys, you know, from way back -- Midwest…
